intents.label: Project Bootstrap
intents.summary: Seeds the embedded Zen DCC workspace and publishes a native session summary.

intents.label: Asset Ingest
intents.summary: Projects a Zen-facing ingest report from the current embedded asset source.

intents.label: Material Bake Preview
intents.summary: Seeds preview buffers and runs a GPU preview bake for live lookdev feedback.

intents.label: Topology Rebuild
intents.summary: Runs Rust graph analysis over the Zen DCC tensor buffer and emits a topology report.

intents.label: Publish Package
intents.summary: Bundles the current Zen DCC seed, GPU preview, and topology report into a publish summary.
